name: Shutter Wipe
description: A camera's focal-plane shutter fires across the frame seen through the camera's gate: metal blades fan down until they cover the frame, then run on and stack below it, uncovering the second clip from the top. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: tilt
params.description: How much the blades tilt on their arms while they travel

params.name: gate
params.description: Width of the camera's gate framing the picture while the shutter fires, in frame heights
